fields.label: Net result
fields.value: Filed U-9194 (omega-arm divergence) and RETRACTED it the same day. The port's arm is CORRECT for a driving car: +0x10 == 0 on 222 of 222 moving frames, on three independent captures

fields.label: The error
fields.value: G-ARM's denominator was all 3623 frames. Car 1 is eliminated at frame 1065 and never moves again, so 2558 of them are a PARKED car. The 70.60% figure was arithmetically right and materially misleading

fields.label: Inside the (b) window
fields.value: +0x10 == 0 on 220 of 220 frames — the arms AGREE exactly where U-9191's 0.9866 deg is measured

fields.label: Still open
fields.value: U-9191 unchanged: is car 1's 0.9866 deg GENERATED or ACCUMULATED? Position join's median induced error is 0.087865 deg, capping admissible claims at ~0.88 deg

fields.label: Keep
fields.value: Do not lengthen the (b) window past frame_idx 1064 — a longer window averages a driving car with a parked one

fields.label: Lesson
fields.value: Stating a denominator is not the same as checking it is the right population

fields.label: Next step
fields.value: Close the 1.3258x distance over-run (U-9185) — now the only substantive physics path — or build a frame-marked join. NOT a +0x10 producer
